tldr: Uranus through the 2nd house disrupts money, security, values, and self-worth.
body:
When Uranus moves through your 2nd house, it interrupts the usual pattern around money, security, possessions, self-worth, spending, income, and what helps you feel steady. You may notice what feels worth keeping, what costs too much, and what would help life feel more stable.

You may need more space, honesty, freedom, experimentation, or a break from the old setup. It can help you see where the current pattern has become too small or too false.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for making a more honest choice around resources, desire, and value.

The caution: Watch for changing everything just to get relief from one pressure point. The risk is confusing immediate comfort with real security.

Uranus moves through this house for a long chapter. Give change room without throwing away the parts of life that still matter.
